## The armed lane (ADR-0339 D1–D2)

`DriverConfig.exposure: Option<ExposureRuntime>` arms the exposure-aware
turn loop; `None` ⇒ byte-identical C0 lane (zero new rows — tested). The
driver owns ordering and every durable append:

```
armed run
  → action.tool.catalog.built            (once per run)
  → action.tool.exposure.planned         (before context.assembled —
                                          durable-before-visible)
  → context.artefact.delivered{tool_surface}   (per direct member, once/run)
per call
  → check_callable before output validation
    refusal → action.tool.call.refused   (never reaches the effect path)
    discover_surfaces → executes in-kernel at dispatch
      → action.tool.discovery.searched{query_hash}   (never raw text)
      → action.tool.surface.revealed    (per admitted hit)
    called direct surface
      → context.artefact.activated{artefact_id = surface_id}  (AC-E3-7)
retention boundary → action.tool.surface.evicted
host sync_exposure_source
  → action.tool.catalog.delta            (always)
  → adopt → catalog.epoch + catalog.built | ask → security.permission.requested
```

Exposure run state folds from the durable prefix
(`fold_exposure_state`) — resume/takeover reconstructs revealed set,
prior order and delivered artefacts with no session memory. The
in-memory `ExposureRunState` is a cache, never authority (CC3).

## C1 producers (DF-S1.17-2)

- `bind_composite` — `PlanMap` bindings: pinned `plan_ref`, S1
  inclusion, `effects_bound` union; `UncheckableSurface` /
  `AuthorityWidening` refusals; canonical codec round-trip.
- `bind_variant` — identity-bearing `family_id`/`variant_id`
  provenance + `check_family` back-pointer (provenance, never the
  identity basis — D4).
- Non-surface granularities (`namespace`/`source`/`catalog`) —
  `NotQueryable` on mismatch, unit hits expand to member ids.
- All eight `CatalogIndex` variants execute; `bind_freeform` /
  `bind_shim` producers; `RenderMode::{concise,offload}` with the
  `preview_lines ≤ threshold_bytes` bound.

## C2 gates (DF-S1.17-3)

- `code_mode` plans produce (`bind_code_mode`); `check_callable`
  admits `from_code` on `code_mode` members only (the executor stays
  R-2.5.5's row — D5).
- `hide_uncovered` omits; `demote_uncovered` drops `direct` —
  demoted, never hidden.
- `SelectionGates.index_unverified` gates `lifted` indexing;
  `pinned ∧ lifted` = `PinBindsLifted` at build and adopt.
- `filesystem` catalogues through the declared executor leg —
  `ExecutorUnavailable` when absent, never a fabricated ranking (D3).
- `discover_surfaces` is a kernel capability executed at dispatch,
  never routed through the effect gate.
